words := "we planted beans and carrots in the garden behind our old house".split(" ")
longest := words[0]
shortest := words[0]
nat total := 0
for word := words[]
    total += #word
    if #word > #longest
        longest = word
    if #word < #shortest
        shortest = word
average := real(total) / real(#words)
println("words: {#words}{NL}longest: {longest}{NL}shortest: {shortest}{NL}average length: {average:.2}")
